# Marketing & Sales Software

> Independent, hands-researched reviews of marketing, sales, e-commerce and growth software. 44 full reviews live here as the canonical version; prices are read on the vendor's page and dated. Last updated 2026-09-02.

AIBuilder Marketplace and its sister sites are run by Daniel Haket, a former banker. Every price is read on the vendor's own page and dated; every review says who should skip the tool. Affiliate links never change a verdict. Six sites, one owner.

## Start here
- [Cost-trap atlas](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/atlas.html): every tool in this niche with its documented pricing traps
- [Price Watch](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/price-watch.html): dated price changes, free-tier cuts and renewal jumps
- [Straight answers](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/answers.html): is it worth it, what does it really cost, what is the catch — per tool
- [Tool finder](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/finder.html): pick a tool in under a minute
- [Deals](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/deals.html): current deals and free trials

## Reviews (44) — canonical versions
- [AdCreative.ai Review (2026): $39/mo, Pay Per Download](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/adcreative-ai-review.html): AdCreative.ai: Credit-metered, where one credit is one downloaded creative, and there is no free plan. The meter counts downloads, not campaigns.
- [AgencyAnalytics Review (2026): From $20/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/agencyanalytics-review.html): AgencyAnalytics: The simplified Core plan is ~$20 per client/mo with no clients included in the base. Cost scales linearly with clients.
- [Aira Review (2026): From €149/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aira-review.html): Aira is €149 per user a month, billed monthly, for the company database, AI prospecting, monitoring and on-demand research.
- [AISDR Review (2026): From $250/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/aisdr-review.html): AISDR: Solo is $250/mo or $2,400/yr for a sales team of one. Autonomous AI outreach is only as good as your targeting, list quality and messaging guar
- [AltText.ai Review (2026): From $5/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/alttext-ai-review.html): AltText.ai: Credit-metered — one credit = one image. The headline ‘5¢ per image’ only holds for a plain JPG in one language.
- [Amplemarket Review (2026): From $600/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/amplemarket-review.html): Amplemarket: The only published price is Startup at $600/mo on an annual term, covering 2 users, with additional users available to purchase.
- [Atria Review (2026): From $129/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/atria-review.html): Atria: Core is $129/mo, a stated $360 saving a year. Its edge is competitor ad intelligence plus creative generation in one place.
- [BidX Review (2026): Part Published, Part on Quote](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/bidx-review.html): BidX: €295 for the default report, custom reports quote-only. The number that decides your bill is the one number the page does not print.
- [Campaign Monitor Review (2026): Real Pricing, Real Limits](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/campaign-monitor-review.html): Campaign Monitor: Contact-based, on three tiers. You pay for contacts, not sends — so a large, quiet list costs the same as a large, active one.
- [Capsule Review (2026): Free Tier Stops at 250 Contacts](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/capsule-review.html): Capsule: Four tiers, each quoted per user a month on annual billing. Capsule's simplicity is the product: it deliberately does less than the CRM giant
- [Close Review (2026): From $1/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/close-review.html): Close: Solo $19, Essentials $49, Growth $109 and Scale $149 per user/mo, or $9, $35, $99 and $139 billed annually. The built-in calling is the draw.
- [Crazy Egg Review (2026): From $29/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/crazy-egg-review.html): Crazy Egg: Three plans, all billed annually, with a 30-day free trial and — in the vendor's words — no overages, ever. The entry plan is thin on recor
- [Dripify Review (2026): Part Published, Part on Quote](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/dripify-review.html): Dripify: Month to month the same tiers read $59, $79 and $99 per user. Understand what you are buying before the price matters.
- [Expandi Review (2026): From $99/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/expandi-review.html): Expandi: Business is $99 per month month-to-month; paying a year up front takes 20% off, which their own page describes as two months free.
- [ExpertSender Review (2026): 30,000 Visits Is the Floor](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/expertsender-review.html): ExpertSender — (2026) Quote-based with a documented floor: their site lists pricing starting around $450/mo, scaling with volume and channels.
- [Fast Bundle Review (2026): Priced on Your Bundle Sales](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/fast-bundle-review.html): Fast Bundle: The listing is free to install and shows four tiers. The most important thing about this app is not on its App Store listing.
- [GrapeLeads Review (2026): $0.56 a Result, Not a Lead](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/grapeleads-review.html): GrapeLeads: Freelancer $28 for 50 credits ($0.56 each), Startup $55 for 100 credits ($0.54) and Agency $127 for 250 credits ($0.51).
- [HubSpot Review (2026): From $7/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/hubspot-review.html): HubSpot: Free is $0 for up to 2 users and 1,000 marketing contacts, with no time limit. Three numbers on this pricing page are not what they look like
- [Kit Review (2026): Free to 10,000 Subscribers, No Automations](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/kit-review.html): Kit: The free plan is $0/mo and covers up to 10,000 email subscribers, with unlimited landing pages and forms.
- [Koongo Review (2026): Trial Terms, Price & Limits](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/koongo-review.html): Koongo: Lite is $39 a month and updates every 6 hours, Starter is $79 and updates every 30 minutes. The headline price is a base, not a bill.
- [Later Review (2026): Starter Caps at 30 Posts](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/later-review.html): Later: Starter $18.75/month, Growth $37.50 and Scale $82.50, all billed yearly. The Starter caps are where the price really lives.
- [Leadfeeder Review (2026): Company Allowance Unpublished](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/leadfeeder-review.html): Leadfeeder: Lite is free forever with a 14-day full trial, seven days of visitor history and the last 100 companies a month.
- [lemlist Review (2026): Part Published, Part on Quote](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/lemlist-review.html): lemlist: No free plan, 14-day trial. The per-seat plus per-email-account model makes total cost unpredictable as you scale.
- [NiceJob Review (2026): From $75/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/nicejob-review.html): NiceJob: Reviews plan about $75/mo and Pro around $125/mo (adds referrals, AI replies, booking reminders). It automates review collection genuinely we
- [Nutshell Review (2026): The Add-Ons Outgrow the CRM](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/nutshell-review.html): Nutshell — Two paid extensions sit alongside: Marketing from $49 a month and Engagement from $16 per user a month. Full API access is included on ever
- [PagePulse Review (2026): $29 Buys Two Pages, Not a Site](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/pagepulse-review.html): PagePulse — Genuinely free tier: $0 for 1 member and 1 page with unlimited traffic. The tiers gate on two axes at once — members AND tracked pages.
- [PartnerStack Review (2026): Quote-Only, We Run 58 Programmes](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/partnerstack-review.html): PartnerStack publishes three plans — Launch, Growth and Enterprise. A record in the Partner API's customers endpoint is a tracked click, not a signup.
- [Pingtree Review (2026): Trial Terms, Price & Limits](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/pingtree-review.html): Pingtree: Self Service is “From $199” per month with a free trial included. We get paid whether or not you ever spend a cent with them.
- [Pipedrive Review (2026): Priced Per Seat, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/pipedrive-review.html): Pipedrive: Billed annually they are US$14, US$39, US$59 and US$79 per seat per month. Pipedrive manages what happens after a lead enters your pipeline
- [Quartile Review (2026): No Price Anywhere on the Site](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/quartile-review.html): Quartile: Budget for this one from a written quote, because nothing else exists. Everything about the sales motion here is a conversation.
- [Rank Math Review (2026): PRO Excludes Client Sites](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/rank-math-review.html): Rank Math: Pro is €7.99 a month, Business €24.99 and Agency €54.99, each billed annually and excluding VAT. Don't pay until you hit those.
- [Reditus Review (2026): Marketplace Needs $4,788/yr Plan](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/reditus-review.html): Reditus: The published entry plan is Growth at $99/mo billed annually — $1,188 once a year. The advertised $99 is the annual-commitment rate.
- [Reply.io Review (2026): $89 Buys Unlimited Contacts](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/reply-io-review.html): Reply.io: Three separate tracks, and the one you pick changes the arithmetic completely. The advertised $89 is the lobby, not the building.
- [Scarcity.AI Review (2026): Real Data, Tunable Truth](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/scarcity-ai-review.html): Scarcity.AI: The Low Stock Counter is $4.99 a month or $41.91 a year at a stated 30% saving, with a 7-day trial; its free tier is Development Stores.
- [Seller Investigators Review (2026): Priced at 25% Commission](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/seller-investigators-review.html): Seller Investigators: One number, and it is the whole model. Contingency pricing is the honest kind — you pay only out of money that arrived.
- [Seller Snap Review (2026): Annual Billing, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/seller-snap-review.html): Seller Snap: Read them as $15,000 and $30,000 a month. Read the caps before you read the prices, because the caps are what you are actually buying.
- [Similarweb Review (2026): From $125/Month, Teams Quote-Only](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/similarweb-review.html): Similarweb: $125 per month on annual billing for Competitive Intelligence, $333 for Competitive Intel & SEO & AEO. Similarweb does publish a price.
- [Spiky.ai Review (2026): Free Tier, Then $15/mo](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/spiky-ai-review.html): Spiky.ai: On annual billing Plus is $15, Pro $24 and Premium $40 per user per month. The number to check first is the meeting cap, not the price.
- [Stamped Review (2026): From $18/mo, Checked Aug 2026](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/stamped-review.html): Stamped: Bundled, all three products came to about $18/month at the 200-order step and $79/month at 1,000 orders. Read the order band, not the headlin
- [Storista Review (2026): Trial Terms, Price & Limits](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/storista-review.html): Storista: AI-generated UGC video at roughly $1 to $4 a render, free to start with a $19 a month Pro plan. Same company, same name, unrelated ladders.
- [Tapita SEO Optimizer Review (2026): A 2.5x Price Spread](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/tapita-seo-optimizer-review.html): Tapita SEO Optimizer: +$5 on the Shopify Grow plan, +$30 on Advanced and +$60 on Shopify Plus. The price on the listing is a Shopify-Basic price.
- [TnC Review (2026): The Free Plan Is Dev Stores Only](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/tnc-review.html): TnC: Development Stores is free and carries every Pro feature.
- [Uniqode Review (2026): Cancel and the Codes Stop](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/uniqode-review.html): Uniqode: The plan cards are rendered in the browser and invisible to a non-browser client. The tier jumps are steep and a lot is gated.
- [ZoomInfo Review (2026): Renewals Rise 10-20% a Year](https://marketingandsalessoftware.com/zoominfo-review.html): ZoomInfo: Contracts typically start around $15k and the median runs near $32k a year, climbing once seats. The contract is the most-cited frustration.
